question: According to the passages, does spaced practice improve long-term retention compared with massed practice, and what caveat is reported?
required_claim: Spaced practice helps retention on average; one study finds the benefit shrinks for very short retention intervals.

passages.text: A campus bookstore reported higher sales of notebooks during midterms than during reading week.
Study R (experiment, n=200) found that spaced practice produced higher long-term retention scores than massed practice after a one-week delay.
Lecture capture downloads peaked on Sunday evenings in the engineering faculty.
An IT ticket log showed printer outages clustered around assignment deadlines.
Student union surveys listed cafeteria wait times as a top complaint.
Study S reported that the spaced-practice advantage was small or absent when the retention test occurred only 20 minutes after study.
A facilities report noted that classroom projectors were replaced in Building C.
